claude.sample_unit: whole-slide images (339 slides from 185 patients, three scanners)
models_evaluated: Fixed detect-then-grade Gleason grading pipeline (developed on North American and European material)

links.outcome: Performance across three scanners: detection AUC and grading agreement by device
links.effect: Detection AUC 0.987 to 0.991 across scanners; grading of confirmed cancers scanner dependent (Grundium 0.63, Leica 0.67, Hamamatsu 0.44).
links.quote: Grading of confirmed cancers was scanner dependent: the compact Grundium (0.63) did not differ from the clinical Leica (0.67; paired difference 0.04, 95% CI -0.03 to 0.11), while both exceeded Hamamatsu (0.44).

links.outcome: Performance of fixed model on local external cohort versus reference pathologist grades
links.effect: Detection transferred to the Iraqi cohort without tuning; grading of confirmed cancers was lower and scanner dependent, supporting confirmation on the local population.
links.quote: Prostate grading models should be deployed as a detect-then-grade pipeline, with grading validated per device and confirmed on the local population.

links.outcome: Performance shift from Western development data to a Middle Eastern cohort
links.effect: Detection transferred with AUC 0.987 to 0.991 without per-population tuning, but grading on confirmed cancers dropped on some scanners (Hamamatsu 0.44).
links.quote: Detection was statistically equivalent across scanners (AUC 0.987 to 0.991; paired differences at most 0.003) and transferred to this non-Western cohort with no per-population tuning.

links.outcome: Deployed detect-then-grade pipeline agreement compared with ungated model and inter-pathologist ceiling
links.effect: Cross-validated all-slide QWK 0.86, 0.81, 0.86 across scanners, matching inter-pathologist ceiling of 0.81, versus 0.23 to 0.62 for the ungated model.
links.quote: At a 95% sensitivity operating point the deployed pipeline reached cross-validated all-slide QWK of 0.86, 0.81, and 0.86 (Grundium, Hamamatsu, Leica), matching the inter-pathologist ceiling of 0.81, against 0.23 to 0.62 for the ungated model.
